shots.subject: Presenter speaking directly to camera in right-third framing.
shots.shot_brief: Medium close-up of presenter, eye-level, neutral background. Presenter looks directly into lens with a serious, conspiratorial tone. Vertical 9:16 composition.
continuity_notes: Maintain consistent lighting and background for all presenter shots.

shots.subject: Animated list of 'commoditized' elements: Script, Thumbnail, Color Grade, Pacing.
shots.shot_brief: Clean, minimalist infographic overlay on the right side or bottom third. Icons for script, image, color wheel, and clock appear sequentially as they are mentioned. Style should be modern and slightly sterile to reflect 'commodity' status.
continuity_notes: Ensure text is legible on mobile screens.

shots.subject: A single, distinct human silhouette standing in a field of identical, blurred grey figures.
shots.shot_brief: Cinematic still image. The central figure is sharp, warm-toned, and detailed. The surrounding figures are monochromatic, blurry, and indistinct. Vertical composition with the subject centered or slightly off-center to allow for text overlay if needed, but primarily visual impact.
continuity_notes: Color grade should match the presenter's warm tones.

shots.subject: Presenter demonstrating 'irrational annoyance' and 'dumb tangent' energy.
shots.shot_brief: Close-up on presenter. The delivery should be more animated than previous shots. Use quick cuts or slight zoom-ins to emphasize the 'specific, slightly broken human' aspect. The presenter might gesture dismissively or lean in conspiratorially.
continuity_notes: Ensure performance matches the script's tone of confident irreverence.

shots.subject: Split screen or pie chart: 'AI Handles' (Cutting, Scoring, Harvesting) vs 'Human Keeps' (Jokes, Face, Opinion).
shots.shot_brief: Dynamic infographic. Left side shows robotic/automated icons for editing tasks. Right side shows human-centric icons for creativity. A visual barrier or line separates them, emphasizing the boundary the presenter refuses to cross.
continuity_notes: Keep animation smooth and non-distracting.

shots.subject: A crowd of people looking at a screen, then turning away with expressions of disinterest or confusion.
shots.shot_brief: Cinematic B-roll. Slow motion. The faces should look generic and unengaged. The lighting is cool and detached. This visualizes the 'audience has a nose for hollow' concept.
continuity_notes: Avoid recognizable faces to maintain universality.

shots.subject: Archival footage or high-quality stills of a jazz band recording session, focusing on the musicians' expressions rather than just the instruments.
shots.shot_brief: Black and white or warm-toned archival clip. Focus on the interaction between musicians, the 'taste' in their playing. If no specific Steely Dan footage is available, use generic high-end jazz ensemble footage that conveys sophistication and human connection.
continuity_notes: Ensure footage is royalty-free or properly licensed.

shots.subject: Presenter in a confident, instructive pose, gesturing to indicate 'balance'.
shots.shot_brief: Medium shot. Presenter uses hand gestures to weigh the 'tools' vs 'person' concept. The tone is advisory and firm. Background remains consistent with previous presenter shots.
continuity_notes: Maintain eye contact with lens.

shots.subject: Bold, minimalist text: 'The only scarce thing left is a person who means it.'
shots.shot_brief: Full-screen text graphic. Clean sans-serif font. The text appears word-by-word or line-by-line in sync with the audio. Background is a subtle, dark gradient to make the white text pop.
continuity_notes: Font size must be readable on small screens.

shots.subject: Presenter delivering the final statement with absolute conviction.
shots.shot_brief: Tight close-up. The presenter's face fills the frame (within 9:16 safe zones). Direct, unblinking eye contact. The delivery is short, punchy, and final. No background distractions.
continuity_notes: Ensure audio is crisp and free of reverb.

shots.subject: Presenter breaking the fourth wall with a smirk or laugh, referencing the 'AI version of me'.
shots.shot_brief: Medium close-up. The presenter's demeanor shifts from serious to playful. A slight head tilt or eyebrow raise accompanies the joke. This breaks the tension and leaves the viewer on a positive, human note.
continuity_notes: Ensure the transition from serious to funny is smooth.
